# 🚀 Nuvio Full iOS v0.4.17

Full official build with touch and button click responsiveness fix, non-blocking native iOS edge-swipe back gestures, Liquid Glass floating tab bar, stable navigation container, indefinite background downloads, notification support, and Files app access.
